verbatim_quote.original: توی فایل‌های مارک‌دان و مخصوصاً فایل‌های مارک‌دانی که برای پرامپت قراره استفاده بشه، به شماره تسک‌ها هم ریفرنس می‌دی. این کار باعث ایجاد توهم برای هوش مصنوعی می‌شه و جالب نیست.
verbatim_quote.english_translation: In Markdown files, especially Markdown files meant to be used as prompts, you also reference task numbers. This causes hallucination for the AI and it is not good.

extracted_decision.summary: Task numbers live ONLY in code comments, CHANGELOG, task files, history archives, and HTML comments — never in prompt-facing Markdown prose (anti-hallucination discipline).
extracted_decision.rationale: Manager observed task-number references in prompt Markdown causing AI hallucination; code comments are fine and welcome.
extracted_decision.tradeoffs: Provenance in prompts is sacrificed for hallucination safety; traceability stays in code/CHANGELOG/tasks.
